description: Experiment and cost budgets (PRD 7.5). Absent or zero values disable the corresponding paid loop; unlimited paid retries are never the default.
max_actions_minutes_note: 0 = Actions budget not yet authorized; macOS builds stay BLOCKED until the user confirms account billing (PRD 8.4).
notes: Budget is cumulative across sessions and recorded per experiment.
